Load published metric tables

Source: R/published.R
npc_load_metrics.Rd

Downloads a precomputed metric table from the package's GitHub releases and caches it, so national metrics are available without building them. The tables are built by data-raw/publish-metrics.R from public NCCS data with npc_build_metrics(), for every metric in npc_metrics() (dynamics included), 501(c)(3) organizations, CBSAs and counties. Each release's README.md gives the years and caveats.

Usage

npc_load_metrics(
  universe = c("filers", "registered", "grassroots"),
  geo = c("cbsa", "county"),
  resource = c("TOTREV", "TOTEXP", "NETASS"),
  vintage = "latest",
  format = c("wide", "long"),
  dir = npc_cache_dir(),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

universe

"filers", "registered" or "grassroots".

geo

"cbsa" or "county".

resource

For filers: "TOTREV", "TOTEXP" or "NETASS". The other universes have no resource.

vintage

Release tag such as "metrics-2026.11", or "latest"; see npc_metric_vintages().

format

"wide" (one row per market, subsector and year, as npc_build_metrics(format = "wide")) or "long" (as its default output).

dir

Cache directory; see npc_cache_dir(). Tables are kept under dir/published/<vintage>/.

refresh

Download again even if cached.

Value

A tibble, with the build manifest as the "manifest" attribute and the vintage as "vintage". Reads Parquet when the arrow package is installed, and gzipped CSV otherwise.

See also

npc_metric_vintages(), npc_dashboard()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
hhi <- npc_load_metrics( "filers", "cbsa", "TOTREV" )
subset( hhi, GEO == "35620" & SUB == "ALL", c( YEAR, N, HHI, ENTRY_RATE ) )

# Everything in the dashboard
npc_dashboard( rbind(
  npc_load_metrics( "filers", "cbsa", format = "long" ),
  npc_load_metrics( "registered", "cbsa", format = "long" ) ) )
} # }
